hand-wraps-badlands.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Badlands
hand-wraps-badlands.desc:
Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. This DIY hand protection is made of scavenged materials.

Felix turns a blind eye towards the Colation Taskforce's unsanctioned boxing league

hand-wraps-caution.name: ★ Hand Wraps | CAUTION!
hand-wraps-caution.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching.

hand-wraps-overprint.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Overprint
hand-wraps-overprint.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. These black bias-tape handwraps have been printed with rubberized geometric patterns.

specialist-gloves-sunburst.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Sunburst
specialist-gloves-sunburst.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

specialist-gloves-tiger-strike.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Tiger Strike
specialist-gloves-tiger-strike.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

specialist-gloves-mogul.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Mogul
specialist-gloves-mogul.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. These wintery gloves would be at home on the ski hill.

awp-elite-build.name: AWP | Elite Build
awp-elite-build.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using a combination of hydrographics and careful stenciling and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

Chase Turner was a great man... you have big shoes to fill – The Phoenix and The Initiate, Part 1

awp-containment-breach.name: AWP | Containment Breach
awp-containment-breach.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted to depict mutated rats trying to escape a radioactive, neon green forest.

Who knows what radioactive diseases they carry…

awp-dragon-lore.name: AWP | Dragon Lore
awp-dragon-lore.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a knotwork dragon.

200 keys could never unlock its secrets

awp-green-energy.name: AWP | Green Energy
awp-green-energy.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A yellow streak runs the length of this custom painted, green metallic flake AWP.

Energy amplified

bayonet-fade.name: ★ Bayonet | Fade
bayonet-fade.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

cz75-auto-tread-plate.name: CZ75-Auto | Tread Plate
cz75-auto-tread-plate.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been covered in a metallic foil with a tread plate pattern.

cz75-auto-honey-paisley.name: CZ75-Auto | Honey Paisley
cz75-auto-honey-paisley.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a gold-colored paisley pattern over a wine-colored base.

Only the finest textiles for you, Booth - Yukako, Gunsmith

desert-eagle-sputnik.name: Desert Eagle | Sputnik
desert-eagle-sputnik.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A space themed pattern consisting of stars and satellites has been applied.

Send and receive

dual-berettas-urban-shock.name: Dual Berettas | Urban Shock
dual-berettas-urban-shock.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been custom painted with urban camo and blue accents.

With lightning always comes thunder

dual-berettas-elite-16.name: Dual Berettas | Elite 1.6
dual-berettas-elite-16.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. ELITE has been stamped on the side of these classic Dual Berettas.

Source material

dual-berettas-rose-nacre.name: Dual Berettas | Rose Nacre
dual-berettas-rose-nacre.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. The metal of these Dual Berettas has been painted rose gold and the grips are a nacred, deep jade color.

You can't make an omelette without cracking a few jeweled eggs

famas-dark-water.name: FAMAS | Dark Water
famas-dark-water.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted in an aquatic-stripe pattern with charcoal metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

Water gives life, but it can also take it...

five-seven-hyper-beast.name: Five-SeveN | Hyper Beast
five-seven-hyper-beast.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with a beastly creature in psychedelic colors.

We're all monsters

glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler
glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

glock-18-off-world.name: Glock-18 | Off World
glock-18-off-world.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been hand painted with multiple coats of blue paint.

The topcoat is still drying

glock-18-candy-apple.name: Glock-18 | Candy Apple
glock-18-candy-apple.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a red and black color scheme.

Great on cars, better on weapons

p2000-sure-grip.name: P2000 | Sure Grip
p2000-sure-grip.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted in gunmetal grey using fractal designs and finished with orange accents.

>>WEAPON FINISH TEXTURE EXPERIMENTS, ENTRY ONE<<

paracord-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Marble Fade
paracord-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

falchion-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Rust Coat
falchion-knife-rust-coat.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

falchion-knife-night.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Night
falchion-knife-night.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

falchion-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Urban Masked
falchion-knife-urban-masked.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

flip-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Flip Knife | Doppler
flip-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Flip Knife | Forest DDPAT
flip-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

gut-knife-bright-water.name: ★ Gut Knife | Bright Water
gut-knife-bright-water.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

gut-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Gut Knife | Safari Mesh
gut-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

navaja-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Doppler
navaja-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-boreal-forest.name: ★ Karambit | Boreal Forest
karambit-boreal-forest.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

kukri-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Urban Masked
kukri-knife-urban-masked.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

m9-bayonet-scorched.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Scorched
m9-bayonet-scorched.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

nomad-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Doppler
nomad-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

shadow-daggers-fade.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Fade
shadow-daggers-fade.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

skeleton-knife-scorched.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Scorched
skeleton-knife-scorched.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

stiletto-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Rust Coat
stiletto-knife-rust-coat.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

stiletto-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Urban Masked
stiletto-knife-urban-masked.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

bowie-knife-lore.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Lore
bowie-knife-lore.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

bowie-knife-autotronic.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Autotronic
bowie-knife-autotronic.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

huntsman-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Crimson Web
huntsman-knife-crimson-web.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

ursus-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Safari Mesh
ursus-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

m4a1-s-knight.name: M4A1-S | Knight
m4a1-s-knight.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has brass inlays with a renaissance armor theme.

What do you mean you can't find Cocinero and Izaki? - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

m4a1-s-mecha-industries.name: M4A1-S | Mecha Industries
m4a1-s-mecha-industries.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It is constructed of hardened ceramic panels.

Featuring all new technology

m4a1-s-icarus-fell.name: M4A1-S | Icarus Fell
m4a1-s-icarus-fell.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted with a hydrographic of feathers and melted wax around a sun motif.

Turner's betrayal is my failure... I have to make this right - Sebastien Hennequet, Sniper

m4a4-sheet-lightning.name: M4A4 | Sheet Lightning
m4a4-sheet-lightning.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A sheet lightning pattern has been spray-painted over a charcoal and gold-colored base.

Blink and you'll miss it

mag-7-bulldozer.name: MAG-7 | Bulldozer
mag-7-bulldozer.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a production line yellow color scheme.

This bone crusher is a devastator

nova-currents.name: Nova | Currents
nova-currents.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. A grayscale pattern highlighted by silver birds has been applied.

How's the view up there?

p250-nuclear-threat.name: P250 | Nuclear Threat
p250-nuclear-threat.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

p90-scarab-rush.name: P90 | ScaraB Rush
p90-scarab-rush.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with scarabs and Egyptian inspired designs.

Resurrection requires death, and death requires rushing

r8-revolver-amber-fade.name: R8 Revolver | Amber Fade
r8-revolver-amber-fade.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

r8-revolver-phoenix-marker.name: R8 Revolver | Phoenix Marker
r8-revolver-phoenix-marker.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. A multicolored pattern of various Phoenix Connexion graffiti has been applied.

"They cannot stop us now!"

r8-revolver-nitro.name: R8 Revolver | Nitro
r8-revolver-nitro.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

ssg-08-tiger-tear.name: SSG 08 | Tiger Tear
ssg-08-tiger-tear.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A forest-colored tiger camo pattern has been applied.

Endangered no more

zeus-x27-olympus.name: Zeus x27 | Olympus
zeus-x27-olympus.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. This custom paint job features Zeus, the God of Thunder.

The air crackles…

tec-9-re-entry.name: Tec-9 | Re-Entry
tec-9-re-entry.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. The barrel has been given a flame decal.

I hate being right all the time - Carmen Cocinero, Extraction Expert

usp-s-alpine-camo.name: USP-S | Alpine Camo
usp-s-alpine-camo.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with a blue and purple camouflage.

Pulled out of cold storage

xm1014-blaze-orange.name: XM1014 | Blaze Orange
xm1014-blaze-orange.desc: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted using a photographic hunting camo hydrographic.
